name: Brandy Blocks
author: YayCommerce

sections.description:
Brandy Blocks extends the WordPress block editor with everything you need to build beautiful, high-converting ecommerce pages.

It adds custom blocks, advanced block enhancements, a 140+ pattern library, and WooCommerce features like wishlist and product comparison. All designed to work seamlessly with the Brandy theme.

Custom Blocks

Build any type of page with purpose-built blocks:

⛩️ Layout & Structure

Container, Collapsible, Modal, Jump to Section

🗒️ Content

Button, Icon, Breadcrumbs, Google Map, Count Down

❝ Testimonials

Full testimonials system with avatar, name, content, rating, and description blocks

🏷️ Pricing

Pricing table and individual pricing card blocks

📋 Forms

Complete form builder: text, email, password, phone, select, radio/checkbox, toggle, and submit

📌 Blog / Posts

Post Template, Relative Posts

🌐 WooCommerce

  • Add to Wishlist
  • Add to Compare List
  • Compare Products
  • Compare Table
  • Quick View Product
  • Recent Viewed Products

Block Enhancements

Extend any existing WordPress or WooCommerce block with:

  • Slider / carousel functionality
  • Box shadow controls
  • Entry animations (fade, slide, zoom, and more)
  • Responsive visibility conditions
  • Hover effects and transitions
  • Grid responsive layout
  • Text gradient color
  • Custom WooCommerce product button styles

140+ Pattern Library

Browse and insert professionally designed block patterns with a built-in React-powered pattern browser. Just search, filter by category, and insert with one click.

E-commerce Features

Wishlist: Let customers save products and return to them later. AJAX-powered, with a dedicated wishlist page via shortcode.

Product Comparison: Side-by-side product comparison with a synchronized list and detailed comparison table.

Works Best With

  • Brandy Theme: Full feature integration
  • Brandy Sites: Blend blocks and templates for an upbeat ecommerce site
  • WooCommerce: Required for e-commerce blocks

HOW TO USE BRANDY BLOCKS

By default, each Brandy block provides individual options and premade styles. You can edit block content within each element. To set up the whole block or parent block options, be sure to look into the Block Settings sidebar.

1. USING TESTIMONIALS

From the block’s top left toolbar, you can either select parent block or individual block to find its respective settings.

  • Set the total of testimonials:

    • Once the whole parent block is selected, look for “Testimonial Count” to edit the number of items.
    • Change the order of testimonials by dragging and dropping each item in the block settings sidebar.

  • Parent block appearance:

    • Carousel: Enable autoplay, edit transition speed, and more.
    • Dimensions: Modify the spacing to fit your design needs.

  • Edit testimonial content in the nested blocks:

    • Customize rating and additional CSS
    • Edit name, title, avatar, and testimonial text.

2. USING PRICING BLOCK

There is a parent block, which contains the multi-column table layout, and the nested blocks.

  • Parent block appearance:

    • Design and edit heading, subheading, and description.
    • Adjust pricing card layout and style.
    • Typography, text color, background color, and custom formatting.
    • Enhance responsiveness by enabling stack on mobile.

  • Highlighted card:

    • Pick the pricing card to stand out and how you want to highlight it.
    • Tweak the color and format of the price display.

  • Pricing plans:

    • Each pricing card comes with customization options in the nested blocks.
    • Enhance the feature list with available/unavailable icons.
    • Fully edit all plan names, descriptions, and lists of features.

We hope that this plugin is useful in helping you create stunning sections and pages for your WordPress ecommerce website. If you have any questions or feedback, please don’t hesitate to chat with us.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from wordpress.org
  2. From your WordPress admin dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New, and upload the plugin zip file
  3. Install and activate it
  4. After activating, you will see the new blocks under the “BRANDY” block group in the Gutenberg editor.
sections.faq:
Do I need the Brandy theme to use this plugin?

No, but the Brandy theme provides the best and most complete experience. Most blocks and features will work with any WordPress theme.

Is WooCommerce required?

WooCommerce is only required if you want to use the e-commerce blocks (wishlist, product comparison, quick view, etc.). All other blocks work without it.

How do I display the wishlist page?

Add the [brandy_wishlist] shortcode to any page.

How do I use the Google Map block?

Go to Settings > Brandy Blocks in your WordPress admin, navigate to the Google Map tab, and enter your Google Maps API key.

How many patterns are included?

The pattern library includes 140+ pre-designed block patterns, organized by category and searchable from within the block editor.

Is this plugin GDPR-compliant?

A big yes, it is compliant with GDPR. It collects no sensitive information.

I have issues with the plugin. How can I get support?

Please create a topic in this plugin’s support forum or contact us to get help. To quickly get the answers, please attach screenshots of currently active WordPress plugins on your website.

Aug 22, 2026 – Version 2.0.0

  • New: AI Layout Builder — describe a section in the post editor, and Brandy composes it for you. It streams progress as it works, preserves partial results if you cancel, and can clone a reference design from an uploaded screenshot.
  • New: Pricing Table — a composable set of Table, Plan, and Options blocks, with a finished three-plan starter design, replacing the old single Pricing block.
  • New: Chart, Badge, Medal, Notice (callout), Info Box, Icon List, Progress Bar, Shape Divider, Social Icons, Team Member, and Table of Contents blocks.
  • New: Slider and Slide — a generic content slider — plus Showcase Slider (fixed frame), Cube Slider, and Loop Slider (a vertical rail that becomes horizontal on smaller screens).
  • New: Rotator, Scroll Statement, Pinned Notes, and Filterable Sections block pairs.
  • New: Posts — a native post loop with responsive columns and slider mode.
  • New: Product Collection — a native product loop with responsive columns and slider mode.
  • New: Avatar Group, with manual and dynamic sources.
  • New: Buttons — a wrapper block that handles alignment for Brandy buttons.
  • New: Load More for Relative Posts loops.
  • New: Tabs can use logos or images for navigation, include a link activated on hover, and offer layout presets with positioned content regions, plus segmented and minimal styles.
  • New: Accordion questions can contain a row of blocks, and items can rotate automatically on a timer, with the progress bar acting as the clock.
  • New: Slider gains continuous auto-scroll, hover-reveal controls, fractional slides per view, outer-slide dimming, faded edges, and a play-preview button in the editor toolbar.
  • New: Button gains copy-to-clipboard functionality with a confirmation tooltip, a Flood hover effect, and reveal and pulse icon animations.
  • New: Frosted Glass toggle, replacing the old Blur extension.
  • New: Image Hotspots icon marker style, independent Before/After label styling, Counter prefix, suffix, and description styling, and Product Categories layout styles with child-category listings.
  • New: Insert images by URL in Media Gallery, Before/After, and Accordion Images.
  • Improved: Blocks now include fully designed default content instead of empty placeholders and display proper previews in the inserter.
